verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Gitea deploys easily on various servers without complex configuration or dependencies. They cite broad OS/architecture support, single-server setups and SQLite as a database option. Hands-on reports back this up: one binary to run, a smooth Docker setup with Certbot for a 45-person team, and far simpler than self-hosted GitLab. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party step-by-step install documentation in the evidence (one user reported docs lacking and relying on Gogs' docs), and evidence that ongoing self-managed upkeep stays light (a startup without dedicated DevOps reported extra maintenance).
